slides.heading: One priority, stated plainly
points: Ship the onboarding rebuild. Nothing else moves ahead of it.
Hold the retainer conversion rate rather than chasing new logos.
Decide on the partner portal by the end of month one, build it or kill it.
Keep the pricing floor. Two losses on price is acceptable.
